cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: One Last Thing
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by discovering one more small task, question, or favor whenever departure seems near.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. One last cup to dry before your taxi arrives.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Could you reach the shelf for it? I'll fetch your coat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's away. The driver's calling; I really have to go.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you put him on speaker first? I should thank him for waiting. What's his name?

mechanism: A uses household and travel-checking expertise to create one more small task whenever B taxi departure becomes imminent.
confusable: Plain conscientious hosting would let the visitor leave; A converts completed cleanup and driver arrival into more expert verifications.
comparison: Window alternative sustains one physical test; cup alternative moves through completed hosting tasks into transport details.
seedUse: Cup drying, shelf and calling driver derive from D26-b; S03 adds correct storage and precise destination verification to the delays.
